reserveReview.rationale: The historical composition remains the September 21 block 26483059 inventory: all thirteen configured positive collateral-vault balances were valued against their exact token/DenManager identities and live liquity-v2-branches source keys. Shutdown/sunset branches retain their positive balances; the pumpBTC quote used its same-block branch oracle when DefiLlama was unavailable. This October 3 review changes classification provenance only, not weights or compositionAsOf. At Berachain block 27028385 (hash 0xc1e8698e0dd085d316fdd73b6ee1b7e8af57f9dea43fd30ef6b990e623d3c738), the exact ylstETH collateral vault asset() is 0xa958090601e21a82e9873042652e35891d945a8c; its name() is CIAN yield layer stETH and symbol() is ylstETH. CIAN's primary documentation identifies ylstETH as its stETH Yield Layer receipt, correcting the former YieldNest obligor attribution. The documented roughly five-day estimate is not a complete Berachain whole-position realization bound, so liquidity remains unknown.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: All configured positive Beraborrow collateral-vault balances observed on Berachain block 26483059 on 2026-09-21
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All configured positive branches are identified and weighted. Wrapper custody, validator, LP unwind, oracle, and liquidation-liquidity risks remain explicit structured risk factors rather than unclassified exposure.
